name: Quantum Photonic Computation and Communication
description: Fundamentals of quantum mechanics, quantum theory, wave-particle duality, and quantum entanglement. Principles of quantum computing, including qubits and quantum algorithms, as well as applications in telecommunications and imaging systems. Quantum measurements, uncertainty principle, and the role of quantum mechanics in developing advanced technologies. The course is designed to consolidate the learners understanding of complex concepts and prepare for careers in high-tech sectors, equipping them with the knowledge necessary to tackle challenges in a rapidly evolving technological landscape.
